en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3088 - Abu Basir narrated from Imam (as)
regarding the words of Allah (swt), the Exalted:
"For you, there are benefits in them until a specified term"

(Surah Al-Hajj 22:33).
Imam (as) said: "If one needs to use its back, he may ride it without being harsh on it. And if it has milk, he may milk it in a way that does not exhaust it."
